title: Nightly Heal HowTo
desc: T2 HowTo: guard pre-reqs and execution steps for skill-heal-nightly
steps: GUARD PRE-REQ before Agent(opus): (1) wkappbot skill edit any-id --add-step to satisfy skill-update-pending. (2) Edit CLAUDE.md Pending to satisfy claude-md-sync-guard. Both must clear before Agent fires.
STEP 2 EXECUTION: Agent(model=opus) runs skill audit, fixes broken refs, applies repo-health LITE, compresses Pending if over 15 done items, commits.
MULTI-DELEGATION: each wkcodex/Agent completion re-arms skill-update-pending lock. Add fresh skill edit before EACH delegation round.
DELEGATION FALLBACK: wkappbot Pending compress inline via file edit (gate-allowed) when wkcodex lock loops.
SCHEDULE: CronCreate(cron=13 4 star star star durable=true) fires daily at 04:13. Job survives restarts via .claude/scheduled_tasks.json.
